name: demo-token-only
title: Demo: a token-only box (version 2, F70 'Nothing')
about: DEMO data, not a real token. F70 step 2 'Nothing': a plain token launch with no NFTs and no vault (boxType TOKEN_ONLY, P). Every collection field is zero or empty, the collection cover included (F74 U3); coverSha256 is the token's logo.

Fees per side (F70): buyers' fees (ETH) go to the creator in ETH (TO_CREATOR), sellers' fees (in the token) are burned (BURN_T); the creator-fee cap add-on limits the creator to 1 ETH per 30 days, the rest burned (F74 U2: a fixed amount). The creator puts 0.05 ETH in at the start (F61 O2).
